svg.aria-label: Slides: eight new layouts and the thumbnail layout picker
svg.title: Slides: eight new layouts and the thumbnail layout picker
svg.text: Slides · new layouts and the layout picker (LAZYAGENTS-121)
Left: the toolbar's layout menu becomes a thumbnail grid drawn from each layout's placeholders in the deck theme. Right: the eight new layouts with sample content.
Click a layout to switch this slide; content moves to matching placeholders (title→title, body→body…).
Keyboard: arrows move between tiles, Enter applies, Esc closes. Current layout is ringed.
the button alone repeats the current layout, as today.
▾ on “+ New slide” opens the same grid (dark deck shown);
Quote · quote
Big number · big-number
Three columns · three-column
Comparison · comparison
Full-bleed image · image-full
Image and text · image-left
Agenda · agenda
Closing · closing
Empty image placeholders (editor only)
Click the dashed box to pick a PNG/JPEG; it fills the frame (cropped to cover)
and keeps the image role, so layout switches move it with the rest.
Empty, the box is never shown in presentation, PDF or PPTX.
Text and image (image-right) gains the same image placeholder.
New roles: body3 (third column), label / label2 (comparison headings).
